added.description:
Head of Engineering — Zealot Labs

New York, NY

On-site
$230K-260K + meaningful equity

Zealot Labs builds AI systems that sit at the center of Western cyber operations, backed by tier-1 U.S. venture investors, with a team drawn from leading AI labs and defense technology companies. This is an early-stage, high-ownership team about to go live with close U.S. allies abroad.

What You'll Do

Own the technical direction and execution of the engineering organization.
Lead, grow, and manage a team of elite security researchers and engineers building AI-driven cyber capabilities.
Set engineering standards, priorities, and culture across the company.
Drive architecture decisions across the platform, from firmware emulation to exploitation to effects delivery.
Work directly with the founders to translate strategic objectives into engineering reality.

Requirements

Proven technical leadership in cyber R&D, vulnerability research, Windows internals research, embedded R&D, or implant development.
Background in offensive security research at organizations like NSA, USCYBERCOM, or defense contractors with similar mandates.
Deep technical credibility — earned through hands-on work, not title.
Ability to recruit, retain, and develop elite technical talent in a competitive market.
Strong judgment on technical risk, prioritization, and resource allocation.

Nice to Have

Experience managing managers or team leaders, not just individual contributors.
Experience scaling an engineering org from early-stage to growth-stage.
Familiarity with AI/ML systems and how they integrate into offensive tooling.
Prior experience building and shipping offensive tools or platforms at scale.
Active security clearance or prior work in classified environments.

You're a technical leader who still thinks like a researcher, who builds teams that punch above their weight, and who wants to be early at a company that will change an industry.
